say:0:1410228001:0.text: That landslide earlier was just a cover to delay construction.
say:0:1410228001:0.source_cn: 看来，下午打发我们的滑坡导致施工就是糊弄人的。

say:1:1410228002:0.text: The dwarves are hiding something bigger than we thought.
say:1:1410228002:0.source_cn: 费心隐瞒，矮人的秘密看来比我们想得要更大。
say:1:1410228002:0.male: The dwarves are hiding something bigger than we thought.
say:1:1410228002:0.female: The dwarves are hiding something bigger than we thought.
